description:
[RSSAmp] Page through the whole directory, newest first. Narrow to one category with kind: blog, news, podcast, music, video, comic, live or reel. The category is decided from the feed document on every crawl, never from what the submitter claimed.

Served by RSSAmp (https://rssamp.com/mcp).

kind.description: Only feeds of this category. Omit for all of them.
